scripts.dev: pnpm dev:prepare && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --env-mode=loose --filter=@tka/web --filter=@tka/api
scripts.ci: pnpm test:checks && pnpm contracts:validate && pnpm contracts:types:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:checks: node --test scripts/check-dev-env.test.mjs scripts/validate-contracts.test.mjs scripts/test-release-chain-guard.test.mjs scripts/qa-accounts.test.mjs scripts/check-test-env.test.mjs
scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm --filter @tka/database build && pnpm --filter @tka/assessment-engine build && pnpm --filter @tka/api openapi:generate
scripts.dev:full: pnpm dev:prepare && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --env-mode=loose --filter=@tka/web --filter=@tka/api --filter=@tka/worker
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm env:check && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @tka/database build && pnpm --filter @tka/assessment-engine build && pnpm db:check
scripts.test:local: dotenv -e .env.test.local -- node scripts/check-test-env.mjs && dotenv -e .env.test.local -- pnpm test
scripts.db:migrate:test: dotenv -e .env.test.local -- node scripts/check-test-env.mjs && dotenv -e .env.test.local -- pnpm --filter @tka/database db:migrate
